biography.characterFamilySituation: Parents deceased, estranged from younger brother in Moscow
biography.characterSkin: Olive-grey, dermal plating visible on forearms and torso
biography.description: A mountain of ork muscle and chrome. Viktor's cybereyes glow a dull amber, and the sub-dermal plating on his forearms catches light like brushed steel. He moves with the controlled precision of someone whose reflexes are wired far beyond natural limits. A faded Spetsnaz tattoo peeks above his collar.
biography.background: Former Russian military — Spetsnaz special operations, discharged after an operation in the SOX went sideways. Drifted to Seattle where his particular skills found ready employment in the shadows. Viktor doesn't talk much about his past but his tactical discipline and comfort with extreme violence speak volumes. He runs the shadows to pay off the chrome that keeps him alive and competitive, and sends what's left to his brother's family in Moscow.

system.description: The most popular heavy pistol in the world, especially among mercenaries and shadowrunners.
The legendary two-handed sword of the samurai, the katana has become synonymous with street samurai and shadowrunners in general.
A reliable, no-frills shotgun that has been in continuous production for nearly 70 years. Favored by professionals and novices alike.
A sturdy combat knife, the runner's best friend.
Heavy full-body armor used by military and high-threat response teams. Covers from head to toe with ballistic plates.
The most popular armor on the streets, available in every style imaginable. Backup armor for less conspicuous situations.
Neural accelerators and adrenaline stimulators implanted through a highly invasive procedure, projecting the user into a world where everything moves in slow motion.
system.gameEffect: Increases Reaction (and thus Initiative) and Initiative Dice by its rating. Can be toggled on/off.

system.description: Synthetic muscles grown in a vat replace or enhance the user's own muscles while calcium treatments and skeletal reinforcement contribute to overall strength.
system.gameEffect: Adds its rating to Strength and Agility. Cannot be combined with other muscle augmentations.

system.description: Plastic and ceramic fiber plates grafted onto the skin. Clearly visible and even more obvious to the touch, but can be embellished with stylized colors and textures.
system.gameEffect: Provides armor bonus equal to its rating (cumulative with other armor sources without causing encumbrance).

system.description: Top-tier cybereyes with extensive capacity for vision enhancements. Provides flawless electronic imaging with built-in visual interface and camera.
Must be paired with a smartgun to take full advantage of the system. Provides targeting data including range, ammo count, barrel temperature, and mechanical stress.
A datajack provides a direct neural interface with retractable micro-cable for plugging into devices.
A character with Toughness shrugs off damage more easily than others.
system.gameEffect: +1 dice pool modifier to Body for damage resistance tests.

system.description: Allows the character to ignore wound modifiers from damage boxes.
system.gameEffect: Ignore 2 boxes of damage when calculating wound modifiers.

system.description: The character has a national SIN from Russia, subject to taxation and tracking.
A rugged step van popular with security firms and shadowrunner teams. Modified with concealed armor plating.
A military-grade medical kit for field treatment of injuries.
system.gameEffect: Provides dice for First Aid tests. Rating determines dice pool.

system.description: Small, concealable communication device with skinlink capability.
Optical binoculars with vision magnification and image link.
Contains essentials for wilderness survival: water purifier, lighter, compass, knife, etc.
A standard flashlight, infrared and low-light capable.
Heavy-duty gloves designed for rappelling and climbing operations.
A grizzled arms dealer operating out of a warehouse near the Tacoma docks. Former military supply sergeant who went private sector.
A discreet street doc with a clinic in Puyallup. Patches up bullet wounds and installs chrome, no questions asked. Owes Viktor a favor from a previous extraction.
An elven fixer with connections throughout the Seattle underworld. She runs meets from a series of rotating locations and is known for her discretion and fair dealings.
